fields.codeHint: Unique uppercase identifier (letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens). Cannot be changed after creation.
fields.codeLockedHint: The function code cannot be changed after creation.
fields.scopeHint: Tenant functions work across all companies; company functions serve only one company.
fields.scopeLockedHint: Scope cannot be changed after creation.
fields.companyHint: Company whose templates may reference this function.
fields.nameHint: Human-readable name for this reusable function (1 to 200 characters).
fields.descriptionHint: Optional notes explaining what this function calculates (up to 1,000 characters).
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe parameters, units, and rounding behavior...

parameters.nameHint: Starts with a lowercase letter, using letters, digits, or underscores (up to 40 characters).
parameters.typeHint: Data type expected for this parameter.
parameters.kindHint: Unit classification checked by the exact decimal engine.
parameters.nullableHint: Allow callers and test cases to pass an empty (null) value.

result.typeHint: Data type returned by this function.
result.kindHint: Unit classification returned by the exact decimal engine.
result.nullableHint: Allow this function to return an empty (null) value.

expression.label: Expression
expression.hint: Typed formula evaluated using only the function parameters and literals.

tests.nameHint: Descriptive name for this test case (1 to 100 characters).
tests.emptyCheckHint: Use an empty (null) value instead of entering one.
tests.decimalHint: Exact decimal value (up to 30 integer and 18 fraction digits).

versions.emptyDescription: Save, validate, and publish this function to create version 1.

detail.title: Version {{version}}
detail.publishedAtHint: Date and time when this version was published.
detail.testsHint: Validation test proof recorded when publishing this version.
detail.changeNoteHint: Summary provided when this version was published.

usage.versionFilterHint: Filter templates referencing a specific published version.
usage.emptyDescription: No template drafts or published versions reference this function yet.

publish.title: Publish function
publish.label: Change note

publish.required: Enter a change note before publishing.

archive.title: Archive function
archive.label: Reason
archive.hint: Explain why this function is being archived (1 to 1,000 characters).
archive.placeholder: Enter the reason for archiving this function...

restore.title: Restore function

restore.hint: Explain why this function is being restored (1 to 1,000 characters).
restore.placeholder: Enter the reason for restoring this function...

impact.title: Check impact of version {{version}}
impact.noDraftTargetsDescription: Only template drafts that reference this function can be checked and updated.
impact.targetsHelp: Select up to 20 draft templates and choose sample data for each.
impact.targetHint: Select this draft to check it against the new version. Up to 20 drafts can be selected.
impact.fixtureHint: Sample fixture used to compare previous and proposed formula values.
impact.expired: Impact check expired. Go back and run the check again.
impact.reasonHint: Explain why these template drafts are being updated (1 to 1,000 characters).
impact.reasonPlaceholder: Enter the reason for applying the new function version...
impact.appliedToast: {{n}} drafts updated. Check them again before publishing.

unsaved.title: Unsaved changes
unsaved.text: You have unsaved changes to this function. Save them before closing or discard them?

conflict.title: Function changed elsewhere
conflict.text: Another user updated this function after you opened it. Reload the latest revision or keep your local changes.

validation.codePattern: Use uppercase letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens (start with a letter or digit).
validation.companyRequired: Select a company for a company-scoped function.
validation.nameTooLong: Name must be 200 characters or fewer.
validation.descriptionTooLong: Description must be 1,000 characters or fewer.
validation.paramNamePattern: Start with a lowercase letter and use only letters, digits, or underscores.
validation.testNameTooLong: Test name must be 100 characters or fewer.
validation.stringTooLong: Text value must be 1,000 characters or fewer.

toasts.validatedFailed: Validation failed. Review the issues on the Tests tab.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.featureDisabled: Reusable template functions are unavailable for this workspace.
errors.notFound: This function could not be found.
errors.STALE: This function was updated elsewhere. Reload the latest version before saving.
errors.FUNCTION_CODE_CONFLICT: A function with this code already exists. Choose a different code.
errors.FUNCTION_ARCHIVED: This function is archived. Restore it before making changes.
errors.FUNCTION_NOT_ARCHIVED: This function is already active and does not need to be restored.
errors.FUNCTION_VALIDATION_STALE: The function changed or its 30-minute proof expired. Validate again before publishing.
errors.FUNCTION_VALIDATION_FAILED: Validation failed. Fix the reported issues and validate again.
errors.FUNCTION_DEPENDENCY_CHANGED: A referenced function changed. Re-validate this function to refresh its dependency checksum.
errors.FUNCTION_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE: This function calls itself through other functions. Remove the loop.
errors.FUNCTION_DEPENDENCY_INVALID: A referenced function version is missing or invalid. Update the expression.
errors.FUNCTION_ARGUMENT_TYPE_MISMATCH: An argument or result type or kind does not match the definition. Update the expression or test values.
errors.FUNCTION_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The function exceeds the allowed size, node count, or test limit. Simplify it and try again.
errors.FUNCTION_DEFINITION_INVALID: The function definition or expression contains an invalid field. Review all parameters and expression blocks.
errors.FUNCTION_SCOPE_MISMATCH: Scope rules prevent this company/tenant reference. Match the scopes and try again.
errors.FUNCTION_NOT_REFERENCED: One or more selected drafts no longer reference this function. Refresh usage and try again.
errors.FUNCTION_IMPACT_STALE: The impact check is out of date. Check again.
errors.FUNCTION_IMPACT_FAILED: Impact check failed for one or more drafts. Fix the reported draft issues and check again.
errors.FUNCTION_TEST_MISMATCH: A test result does not match the expected value. Fix the expression or expected output.
errors.FUNCTION_TEST_PROOF_INVALID: Add at least one passing test case and validate again before publishing.
errors.FUNCTION_PACKAGE_INCOMPATIBLE: The template engine or schema version is incompatible with this function. Re-validate and try again.
errors.FUNCTION_CHECKSUM_INVALID: The function checksum does not match the saved revision. Reload and validate again.
errors.CORE_TEMPLATE_FUNCTION_IMPACT_TIMEOUT: The impact check timed out. Select fewer drafts and try again.
